crossRefs.note: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
“ ‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals…
You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains.…
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

translations.web: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.
translations.bsb: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
translations.kjv: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained
translations.asv: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Jehovah sustaineth me.
